title: Lamrim Weekend Teaching
description: A comprehensive two-day teaching on the Stages of the Path to Enlightenment, covering the practices of the three scopes.

title: Vesak Celebration & Blessing
description: Annual celebration commemorating the birth, enlightenment, and parinirvana of Lord Buddha, with special prayers and blessings.

title: Seven-Day Meditation Retreat
description: An immersive week-long retreat combining shamatha and vipashyana meditation practices under the guidance of His Eminence.

title: Avalokiteshvara Empowerment
description: Initiation into the practice of Avalokiteshvara, the Buddha of Compassion, including transmission of the six-syllable mantra.

title: Summer Philosophy Intensive
description: An intensive study program covering Madhyamaka philosophy and the Middle Way view, suitable for intermediate and advanced students.

title: Nagarjuna's Fundamental Wisdom Teaching
description: A detailed commentary on Nagarjuna's Mulamadhyamakakarika, exploring the profound view of emptiness and dependent origination.

title: Autumn Retreat & Silent Meditation
description: A silent retreat combining structured meditation sessions, contemplation, and personal practice in a supportive environment.

title: Lama Chopa Ceremony
description: The Guru Puja offering ceremony, a profound practice of devotion and accumulation of merit within the Gelugpa tradition.
